arxiv-2010-03616.title: Establishing limits for the monopole production in pp accelerators
arxiv-2010-03616.creator: B. M. Carlos, M. B. Gay Ducati
arxiv-2010-03616.description: Abstract The spin 1 / 2 1/2 magnetic monopole pair production and the spin 0 0 monopolium production are studied in proton-proton collisions. The velocity-dependent coupling model and an additional effective coupling with a magnetic moment parameter are used to calculate the photon fusion and Drell Yan pair production cross sections.

arxiv-2012-06961.title: Online Stochastic Optimization with Wasserstein Based Non-stationarity
arxiv-2012-06961.creator: Jiashuo Jiang † \text{Jiashuo Jiang}^{\dagger} Xiaocheng Li ‡ \text{Xiaocheng Li}^{\ddagger} Jiawei Zhang † \text{Jiawei Zhang}^{\dagger}
arxiv-2012-06961.description: Abstract Abstract: We consider a general online stochastic optimization problem with multiple budget constraints over a horizon of finite time periods. In each time period, a reward function and multiple cost functions are revealed, and the decision maker needs to specify an action from a convex and compact action set to collect the reward and consume the budgets.

arxiv-2207-11442.title: μ ​ KG \mu\text{KG} : A Library for Multi-source Knowledge Graph Embeddings and Applications
arxiv-2207-11442.creator: Xindi Luo, Zequn Sun 0, Wei Hu (✉)
arxiv-2207-11442.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Xindi Luo, Zequn Sun 0, Wei Hu (✉). This paper presents μ ​ KG \mu\text{KG} , an open-source Python library for representation learning over knowledge graphs. μ ​ KG \mu\text{KG} supports joint representation learning over multi-source knowledge graphs (and also a single knowledge graph), multiple deep learning libraries (PyTorch and TensorFlow2), multiple embedding tasks (link prediction, entity alignment, entity typing, and multi-source link prediction), and multiple parallel computing modes (multi-process and multi-GPU computing).

arxiv-2311-08866.title: A Formalization of Finite Group Theory: Part II
arxiv-2311-08866.creator: David M. Russinoff
arxiv-2311-08866.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by David M. Russinoff. This is the second installment of an exposition of an ACL2 formalization of finite group theory. The first, which was presented at the 2022 ACL2 workshop, covered groups and subgroups, cosets, normal subgroups, and quotient groups, culminating in a proof of Cauchy’s Theorem: If the order of a group G G is divisible by a prime p p , then G G has an element of order p p .

arxiv-2312-00775.title: Towards Generalizable Zero-Shot Manipulation via Translating Human Interaction Plans
arxiv-2312-00775.creator: Homanga Bharadhwaj, Abhinav Gupta, Vikash Kumar, Shubham Tulsiani
arxiv-2312-00775.description: Abstract We pursue the goal of developing robots that can interact zero-shot with generic unseen objects via a diverse repertoire of manipulation skills and show how passive human videos can serve as a rich source of data for learning such generalist robots.

arxiv-2402-07590.title: Magnetic phases of XY model with three-spin terms: interplay of topology and entanglement
arxiv-2402-07590.creator: Rakesh Kumar Malakar, Asim Kumar Ghosh
arxiv-2402-07590.description: Abstract Magnetic and topological properties along with quantum correlations in terms of several entanglement measures have been investigated for an antiferromagnetic spin-1/2 XY model in the presence of transverse magnetic field and XZX − - YZY type of three-spin interactions. Symmetries of the spin Hamiltonian have been identified.

arxiv-2402-15618.title: Role of chalcogen vacancies and hydrogen in the optical and electrical properties of bulk transition-metal dichalcogenides
arxiv-2402-15618.creator: Shoaib Khalid, Anderson Janotti, Bharat Medasani
arxiv-2402-15618.description: Abstract Like in any other semiconductor, point defects in transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) are expected to strongly impact their electronic and optical properties. However, identifying defects in these layered two-dimensional materials has been quite challenging with controversial conclusions despite the extensive literature in the past decade.

arxiv-2405-16964.title: Exploring the LLM Journey from Cognition to Expression with Linear Representations
arxiv-2405-16964.creator: Yuzi Yan, Jialian Li, Yipin Zhang, Dong Yan
arxiv-2405-16964.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yuzi Yan, Jialian Li, Yipin Zhang, Dong Yan. This paper presents an in-depth examination of the evolution and interplay of cognitive and expressive capabilities in large language models (LLMs), with a specific focus on Baichuan-7B and Baichuan-33B, an advanced bilingual (Chinese and English) LLM series. We define and explore the model’s cognitive and expressive capabilities through linear representations across three critical phases: Pretraining, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF).

arxiv-2512-12914.title: CTIGuardian: A Few-Shot Framework for Mitigating Privacy Leakage in Fine-Tuned LLMs
arxiv-2512-12914.creator: Shashie Dilhara Batan Arachchige, Benjamin Zi Hao Zhao, Hassan Jameel Asghar, Dinusha Vatsalan, Dali Kaafar
arxiv-2512-12914.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) are often fine-tuned to adapt their general-purpose knowledge to specific tasks and domains such as cyber threat intelligence (CTI). Fine-tuning is mostly done through proprietary datasets that may contain sensitive information. Owners expect their fine-tuned model to not inadvertently leak this information to potentially adversarial end users.

europmc-pmc2412862.description: Background Activation of the peripheral innate immune system stimulates the secretion of CNS cytokines that modulate the behavioral symptoms of sickness. Excessive production of cytokines by microglia, however, may cause long-lasting behavioral and cognitive complications. The p

pmc-11376530.title: Focal spleen lesions in loiasis: A pilot study in Gabon
pmc-11376530.creator: Bayode R. Adegbite, Federico G. Gobbi, Cristina Mazzi, Fabrice Beral M’Baidiguim, Anita Lumeka, Andréa R.O Obele Ndong, Jean R. Edoa, Yabo J. Honkpéhèdji, Jeannot F. Zinsou, Jean C. Dejon-Agobé, Rella Zoleko-Manego, Michael Ramharter, Ayola A. Adegnika, Francesca Tamarozzi
pmc-11376530.description: BackgroundInfection with the filarial nematode Loa loa, endemic in Central and Western Africa, has been associated with increased morbidity and mortality. A number of reports described the presence of spleen nodules, originating from degenerating microfilariae, in humans and animals infected with L. loa.

pmc-11589233.title: Conjunctival Collagen Cross-Linking for the Treatment of Leaking Avascular Cystic Bleb
pmc-11589233.creator: Ali Mert Koçer, Büşra Turpçuoğlu
pmc-11589233.description: Trabeculectomy is a primary surgical procedure used to reduce intraocular pressure (IOP) in patients with glaucoma. Despite its effectiveness, it can lead to significant complications, including hypotony, choroidal effusion, blebitis, and bleb leaks. Bleb leaks require prompt medical or surgical intervention to prevent severe complications such as blebitis and bleb-associated endophthalmitis.

pmc-12366068.title: Epidemiology of tuberculosis and HIV coinfection among inpatients in chengdu, china, 2018–2022
pmc-12366068.creator: Xian-Zhen Tang, Yan Ma, Yao Ma, Qing Chen, Li-Ping Zou, Xiao-Yan Fu, Tao Huang, Shen-Jie Tang, Gui-Hui Wu
pmc-12366068.description: BackgroundTuberculosis (TB) and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection are infectious diseases that pose serious threats to human health. TB and HIV can interact to promote the progression of diseases. This study aims to provide basic evidence for the formulation of disease prevention and control strategies.

pmc-12397284.title: Solvent-driven spectroscopic and quantum chemical evaluation of 2-[(trimethylsilyl) ethynyl]thiophene with molecular docking insights
pmc-12397284.creator: Vaithilingam Sasikala, Saminathan Kayarohanam, Vadivelu Balachandran, Merfat S Al-Sharif, Samy F Mahmoud, Natarajan Elangovan, Ling Shing Wong, Sinouvassane Djearamane
pmc-12397284.description: Thiophene derivatives are recognised for their notable biological and pharmacological properties. This study examines the electronic structure and antibacterial properties of 2-[(Trimethylsilyl)ethynyl]thiophene (2TSET), emphasising the effects of solvent environments. We utilised spectroscopic techniques such as Fourier transform infrared (FT-IR), ultraviolet-visible (UV-Vis), and Raman spectroscopy (FT-Raman) to verify the molecular geometry of 2TSET.

pmc-12639463.title: Quantification of eight clinically relevant serum adrenal steroids in infants by UHPLC-APCI-MS/MS
pmc-12639463.creator: Manuela R Martinefski, Verónica Ambao, María Gabriela Ballerini, María Eugenia Rodriguez, Rodolfo A Rey, María Eugenia Monge, María Gabriela Ropelato
pmc-12639463.description: Highlights•A new UHPLC-APCI-MS/MS-based method was validated to determine eight serum steroids.•It requires 4-fold less sample volume than traditional immunoassays.•It was successfully applied to infants under three months of age.•It has large impact on the assessment of paediatric adrenal disorders in Argentina.Keywords: Adrenal disorders, Paediatric samples, Steroid profile, UHPLC-APCI-MS/MS Introduction Accurate and timely diagnosis of adrenal disease is challenging in paediatrics.

pmc-13222787.title: Solid-variant primary pulmonary adenoid cystic carcinoma with pleural metastasis and malignant pleural effusion: a rare case report
pmc-13222787.creator: Suyi Guo, Yang Zhai, Hongbian Gao, Caixia Ding
pmc-13222787.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPulmonary adenoid cystic carcinoma (PACC) is a rare salivary gland-type malignancy, accounting for 0.04%–0.2% of primary lung neoplasms. The solid variant with pleural metastasis and malignant pleural effusion is exceptionally uncommon, posing significant diagnostic and therapeutic challenges.Case presentationWe report a 65-year-old man whose lung biopsy was initially interpreted as squamous cell carcinoma without keratinization in the setting of basaloid morphology and p40/p63 positivity.

pmc-13519281.title: Evaluating the Accuracy, Empathy, and Readability of Generative AI Versus Registered Nurses in Discharge Planning: A Vignette‐Based Study
pmc-13519281.creator: Yike Wang, Meiyan Ji, Xinghua Bai, Yuan Zhuang
pmc-13519281.description: AimTo compare the multidimensional performance of discharge instructions generated by generative AI (GPT‐4) versus those created by clinical registered nurses across three dimensions—accuracy, empathy and readability—and to explore the impact of patient.DesignA prospective, double‐blind, vignette‐based cross‐sectional study.MethodsFive standardized multidisciplinary discharge scenarios were constructed. Discharge instructions were generated independently by five registered nurses and GPT‐4.

pmc-13532574.title: Moon Insight: a conceptual framework for future lunar exploration
pmc-13532574.creator: Yang Liu, Yongliao Zou, Chi Wang
pmc-13532574.description: The Moon Insight conceptual framework aims to map lunar lava tubes and understand their shapes and internal structures. It will use these natural underground spaces to study the Moon's interior and volcanic history, improve our understanding of how the Moon formed and evolved, and support future lunar bases, long-term human stays, scientific research, and resource use.
